info.title: Storefront API
info.description:
A small shop: a public catalogue of products with their images, carts and orders for the
customers (bearer token), and a back office (API key).

Errors share one envelope, `{ statusCode, error, message, details? }`; validation errors list
every problem in `details`.

tags.description: Products and their images. Public, except the back-office operations.

post.description:
Adds units to the line of the product (a cart has one line per product). The body is validated
by a Valibot schema.

200.description: The cart, with its new totals.

post.description:
Orders every line of a cart, which is then closed. A card payment is captured at once (status
`paid`); a transfer gives the reference and the IBAN to use (status `awaiting-transfer`).

requestBody.description: The cart and the payment. `payment.method` selects the payment option.

201.description: The order. Its URL is in the `location` header.

get.description:
Back office: an API key with the `admin` role. Every order as newline-delimited JSON (one `Order`
document per line), streamed as it is read: the export never holds every order in memory, and a
client that disconnects stops it.

post.description:
Back office: an API key with the `catalog` role. The SKU is stored in upper case, the tags in
lower case, and the price, sent in euros as a decimal string (`"14.90"`), in cents.

201.description: The new product. Its URL is in the `location` header.

403.description: The credentials are valid, but do not grant this operation

409.description: A product with this SKU already exists

post.description:
Validates a product without adding it, and answers what `POST /products` would store: the
output of the `CreateProduct` schema (normalised SKU and tags, price in cents, defaults applied).
The request body is the schema **input** (`CreateProductInput` in the document), the response
its **output** (`CreateProduct`).

get.description: Public and cacheable: `` works without credentials. Conditional requests (`if-none-match`) answer `304`, and `range` requests `206`.

206.description: The part of the image asked for with `range`

304.description: The image did not change since the `etag` sent in `if-none-match`

404.description: No product with this id, or no image

put.description:
A `multipart/form-data` body with one `image` file field: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 1 MiB. The
declared media type is checked while the body arrives (`415`), then the content itself: a file
that is not really one of these images is refused too.
